_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values.
_api_keys_comment: API keys required per source — see notes below

nasa._key_comment: FREE — get a personal key at https://api.nasa.gov/ (no credit card). Set nasa_api_key at the top level of this file. The default DEMO_KEY works at low volume (30 req/hr).

classics._key_comment: NO KEY REQUIRED — the Metropolitan Museum API is fully public.

impressionism._key_comment: NO KEY REQUIRED — the Art Institute of Chicago API is fully public.

schedules._comment: Annual date — null interval means: pick one image on Jan 1 and hold it all day. mode is irrelevant when interval_minutes is null.
schedules.name: new-years-nasa

schedules._comment: Date range — rotates through classics every 90 minutes all December. Use interval_minutes: null instead if you want one image held for the whole month.
schedules.name: december-classics

schedules._comment: Tier 4 — time window (same-day only, no midnight wrap in v1)
schedules.name: morning-impressionism

schedules._comment: Default (no condition = always matches, lowest priority)
schedules.name: default
